olivia: Quick sync request — CloudForge + EdgeCore asked for a coordinated launch around 4/15 for OpenRaven-13B (open-weight). We need marketplace listing, hardware-optimized build, SI integration notes, and joint announcement cadence. Can we aim for partner-only preview 4/15, public announce 4/22? Who needs to own legal/packaging/marketplace items? @sara @lee

miguel: I can own the CloudForge listing and revenue-share draft. 4/15 preview -> 4/22 public sounds fine. Need SKU + pricing by EOD Wed. 

sara: Legal quick notes: export control review required (model classification + datasets used). Redistribution clause: partners may distribute inference artifacts internally but cannot rehost a downloadable public copy without explicit redistribution rights. Suggest adding attribution + no-derivatives clause for the first 12 months. Short contract snippet below: 
```
Redistribution: Provider grants Partner a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to host and serve the Model via Partner’s marketplace and hardware appliances solely for end-user inference. Partner shall not distribute Model weights or otherwise make the Model downloadable to third parties without Provider’s prior written consent.
```
Also request list of jurisdictions from EdgeCore (they deploy in APAC/EU).

lee (engineering): Packaging + infra notes: we need an EdgeCore-optimized artifact (INT8 safetensors bundle) + a Redwood runtime container that pins kernel flags. Deliverables: quantized model tarball, container image, performance matrix (p50/p95 latency @ 1/4/8 tokens, throughput @ batch sizes), and a quickstart script. Example pack command: 
```bash
./pack_model.sh --model openraven-13b --format safetensors --quant int8 --profile edgecore --out openraven-13b-edge.tgz
docker build -t rdw/model-runtime:openraven-13b-edge-v1 .
```
We also need a small test harness for the SI (Postman collection + sample prompt set). ETA: build + perf matrix by next Tue if legal signoff OK.

ryan (product): Canary/rollout plan: start with partner preview traffic (10% bucket) to EdgeCore nodes, monitor quality (per-prompt accuracy on eval set) + cost metrics. If quality drops > reg threshold, auto-fallback to smaller model variant (openraven-7b) for that route. Need release notes + known-limitations doc for the marketplace page. I'll draft the rollout policy.

olivia: Thanks — tallying owners: Miguel = CloudForge listing & pricing; Lee = build + perf artifacts + SI quickstart; Sara = legal signoff + export check; Ryan = rollout/docs; Olivia = announcement coordination + partner comms. I'll ping Amy at CloudForge (amy@cloudforge) and Martin at EdgeCore to lock embargo.

miguel: Can we also confirm revenue split prelim numbers to include in the partner brief? CloudForge usually wants a revenue-share slide. Miguel-> finance for %s. :+1:

sara: Also flag: dual-licensing request may come from partner (MIT for code + restrictive for weights). We should default to Provider-owned weights license + allow commercial marketplace hosting. Will share suggested language later today.

lee (engineering): Small note on determinism: we need to publish seed/decoding defaults and include KV cache compatibility notes for the EdgeCore runtime. Also confirm that we can ship a quantized variant without source training data.

announce-bot: Reminder: embargo window set in calendar when Olivia creates private event. Use channel #release-war-room for the actual announce plan.

olivia: Can everyone drop a 1-line blocker by EOD? I’ll compile checklist and propose a 30-min sync Thurs morning to finalize.

miguel: blocker: final SKU + price by Wed EOD.

sara: blocker: export signoff + sample clause approval by Thu morning.

lee (engineering): blocker: build infra access for EdgeCore test fleet (need creds + sample data) — pinging infra.

ryan (product): blocker: need canary metrics dashboard created in Console (I'll create the ticket).

olivia: Great — thanks team. Sync Thurs 9:30 PT. :thumbsup:
